<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Support;

use Filament\Support\Icons\Heroicon;
use Spatie\MediaLibrary\MediaCollections\Models\Media;

/**
 * Categoria di file di un asset, ai fini della sola presentazione (icona).
 *
 * Logica di presentazione tenuta fuori dal model Media (di spatie): la mappa
 * mime/estensione → categoria → icona vive qui, riusabile da qualunque vista e
 * testabile in isolamento. Se in futuro arriverà un model Media custom (#18,
 * metadati), potrà esporre `icon()` come one-liner che delega a questo enum.
 */
enum AssetFileType
{
    case Image;
    case Audio;
    case Video;
    case Pdf;
    case Archive;
    case Document;
    case Spreadsheet;
    case Cad;
    case Generic;

    /**
     * Risolve la categoria da un media (estrae mime + estensione e delega a
     * {@see self::fromMime()}). Adapter di comodo: la logica resta in fromMime.
     */
    public static function fromMedia(Media $media): self
    {
        $mime = $media->getAttribute('mime_type');
        $fileName = $media->getAttribute('file_name');
        $extension = is_string($fileName) ? pathinfo($fileName, PATHINFO_EXTENSION) : null;

        return self::fromMime(
            is_string($mime) ? $mime : null,
            $extension,
        );
    }

    /**
     * Risolve la categoria dal mime-type, con fallback sull'estensione per i
     * tipi il cui mime è inaffidabile o assente (dwg, zip, office…).
     */
    public static function fromMime(?string $mime, ?string $extension = null): self
    {
        $mime = strtolower(trim($mime ?? ''));
        $ext = strtolower(trim($extension ?? ''));

        // Estensione prima: per questi il mime spesso è generico/assente.
        $byExtension = match ($ext) {
            'dwg', 'dxf' => self::Cad,
            'zip', 'rar', '7z', 'tar', 'gz', 'bz2' => self::Archive,
            'doc', 'docx', 'odt', 'rtf' => self::Document,
            'xls', 'xlsx', 'ods', 'csv' => self::Spreadsheet,
            'pdf' => self::Pdf,
            default => null,
        };
        if ($byExtension !== null) {
            return $byExtension;
        }

        return match (true) {
            str_starts_with($mime, 'image/') => self::Image,
            str_starts_with($mime, 'audio/') => self::Audio,
            str_starts_with($mime, 'video/') => self::Video,
            $mime === 'application/pdf' => self::Pdf,
            in_array($mime, [
                'application/zip',
                'application/x-zip-compressed',
                'application/x-7z-compressed',
                'application/x-rar-compressed',
                'application/x-rar',
                'application/gzip',
                'application/x-tar',
                'application/x-bzip2',
            ], true) => self::Archive,
            in_array($mime, [
                'application/msword',
                'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document',
                'application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.text',
                'application/rtf',
            ], true) => self::Document,
            in_array($mime, [
                'application/vnd.ms-excel',
                'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet',
                'application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.spreadsheet',
                'text/csv',
            ], true) => self::Spreadsheet,
            in_array($mime, [
                'image/vnd.dwg',
                'application/acad',
                'application/x-acad',
                'application/dwg',
                'application/x-dwg',
                'application/autocad_dwg',
                'drawing/dwg',
            ], true) => self::Cad,
            str_starts_with($mime, 'text/') => self::Document,
            default => self::Generic,
        };
    }

    /**
     * Comodità: l'asset è un'immagine (anteprima mostrabile, dimensioni estraibili).
     * Punto unico per la distinzione "è immagine?" usata da UI e pipeline.
     */
    public function isImage(): bool
    {
        return $this === self::Image;
    }

    public function isVideo(): bool
    {
        return $this === self::Video;
    }

    public function isAudio(): bool
    {
        return $this === self::Audio;
    }

    public function isPdf(): bool
    {
        return $this === self::Pdf;
    }

    /**
     * Riproducibile inline con un player (audio/video). NB: indica la categoria,
     * non garantisce il supporto codec/contenitore del browser.
     */
    public function isPlayable(): bool
    {
        return $this->isVideo() || $this->isAudio();
    }

    /**
     * Ingrandibile (zoom/lightbox) dal pannello info: immagini e video "in grande",
     * PDF in un viewer embedded. Gli altri tipi (audio, archivi, documenti, cad,
     * generici) non hanno zoom. Punto unico per la distinzione usata dalla UI.
     */
    public function isZoomable(): bool
    {
        return $this->isImage() || $this->isVideo() || $this->isPdf();
    }

    /**
     * Icona Heroicon rappresentativa della categoria.
     */
    public function icon(): Heroicon
    {
        return match ($this) {
            self::Image => Heroicon::OutlinedPhoto,
            self::Audio => Heroicon::OutlinedMusicalNote,
            self::Video => Heroicon::OutlinedFilm,
            self::Pdf => Heroicon::OutlinedDocumentText,
            self::Archive => Heroicon::OutlinedArchiveBox,
            self::Document => Heroicon::OutlinedDocument,
            self::Spreadsheet => Heroicon::OutlinedTableCells,
            self::Cad => Heroicon::OutlinedCubeTransparent,
            self::Generic => Heroicon::OutlinedPaperClip,
        };
    }
}

content.text: Ho un quadro chiaro. L'AssetManager è una Page custom (griglia blade, non tabella Filament), quindi i filtri saranno stato Livewire applicato a `getAssets()`. Prima di implementare, due decisioni di design che cambiano parecchio l'implementazione:

questions.question: I filtri devono agire solo sulla cartella attualmente aperta o su tutti gli asset del record?

options.label: Tutti gli asset (vista piatta)
options.description: Quando almeno un filtro è attivo, la griglia mostra una vista piatta di tutti i file del record che matchano, ignorando le cartelle. È il comportamento tipico di un DAM: cerchi un file senza sapere dove sta. Senza filtri attivi torna la normale navigazione a cartelle.

options.label: Solo cartella corrente
options.description: I filtri restringono solo i file della cartella aperta; la navigazione resta cartella per cartella. Più semplice ma i filtri trovano meno.

questions.question: Il filtro "tipo di file" con quali opzioni?

options.label: Immagine / Video / Documento
options.description: Esattamente le 3 come da tua indicazione. 'Documento' raggruppa tutto il resto (pdf, office, cad, archivi, audio, generici).

options.label: Categorie puntuali
options.description: Usa le categorie già esistenti in AssetFileType (Immagine, Video, PDF, Documento, Foglio di calcolo, CAD, Archivio, Audio). Più granulare, riusa l'enum senza mappature aggiuntive.

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Support;

use Filament\Support\Icons\Heroicon;
use Spatie\MediaLibrary\MediaCollections\Models\Media;

/**
 * Categoria di file di un asset, ai fini della sola presentazione (icona).
 *
 * Logica di presentazione tenuta fuori dal model Media (di spatie): la mappa
 * mime/estensione → categoria → icona vive qui, riusabile da qualunque vista e
 * testabile in isolamento. Se in futuro arriverà un model Media custom (#18,
 * metadati), potrà esporre `icon()` come one-liner che delega a questo enum.
 */
enum AssetFileType
{
    case Image;
    case Audio;
    case Video;
    case Pdf;
    case Archive;
    case Document;
    case Spreadsheet;
    case Cad;
    case Generic;

    /**
     * Risolve la categoria da un media (estrae mime + estensione e delega a
     * {@see self::fromMime()}). Adapter di comodo: la logica resta in fromMime.
     */
    public static function fromMedia(Media $media): self
    {
        $mime = $media->getAttribute('mime_type');
        $fileName = $media->getAttribute('file_name');
        $extension = is_string($fileName) ? pathinfo($fileName, PATHINFO_EXTENSION) : null;

        return self::fromMime(
            is_string($mime) ? $mime : null,
            $extension,
        );
    }

    /**
     * Risolve la categoria dal mime-type, con fallback sull'estensione per i
     * tipi il cui mime è inaffidabile o assente (dwg, zip, office…).
     */
    public static function fromMime(?string $mime, ?string $extension = null): self
    {
        $mime = strtolower(trim($mime ?? ''));
        $ext = strtolower(trim($extension ?? ''));

        // Estensione prima: per questi il mime spesso è generico/assente.
        $byExtension = match ($ext) {
            'dwg', 'dxf' => self::Cad,
            'zip', 'rar', '7z', 'tar', 'gz', 'bz2' => self::Archive,
            'doc', 'docx', 'odt', 'rtf' => self::Document,
            'xls', 'xlsx', 'ods', 'csv' => self::Spreadsheet,
            'pdf' => self::Pdf,
            default => null,
        };
        if ($byExtension !== null) {
            return $byExtension;
        }

        return match (true) {
            str_starts_with($mime, 'image/') => self::Image,
            str_starts_with($mime, 'audio/') => self::Audio,
            str_starts_with($mime, 'video/') => self::Video,
            $mime === 'application/pdf' => self::Pdf,
            in_array($mime, [
                'application/zip',
                'application/x-zip-compressed',
                'application/x-7z-compressed',
                'application/x-rar-compressed',
                'application/x-rar',
                'application/gzip',
                'application/x-tar',
                'application/x-bzip2',
            ], true) => self::Archive,
            in_array($mime, [
                'application/msword',
                'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document',
                'application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.text',
                'application/rtf',
            ], true) => self::Document,
            in_array($mime, [
                'application/vnd.ms-excel',
                'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet',
                'application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.spreadsheet',
                'text/csv',
            ], true) => self::Spreadsheet,
            in_array($mime, [
                'image/vnd.dwg',
                'application/acad',
                'application/x-acad',
                'application/dwg',
                'application/x-dwg',
                'application/autocad_dwg',
                'drawing/dwg',
            ], true) => self::Cad,
            str_starts_with($mime, 'text/') => self::Document,
            default => self::Generic,
        };
    }

    /**
     * Comodità: l'asset è un'immagine (anteprima mostrabile, dimensioni estraibili).
     * Punto unico per la distinzione "è immagine?" usata da UI e pipeline.
     */
    public function isImage(): bool
    {
        return $this === self::Image;
    }

    public function isVideo(): bool
    {
        return $this === self::Video;
    }

    public function isAudio(): bool
    {
        return $this === self::Audio;
    }

    public function isPdf(): bool
    {
        return $this === self::Pdf;
    }

    /**
     * Riproducibile inline con un player (audio/video). NB: indica la categoria,
     * non garantisce il supporto codec/contenitore del browser.
     */
    public function isPlayable(): bool
    {
        return $this->isVideo() || $this->isAudio();
    }

    /**
     * Ingrandibile (zoom/lightbox) dal pannello info: immagini e video "in grande",
     * PDF in un viewer embedded. Gli altri tipi (audio, archivi, documenti, cad,
     * generici) non hanno zoom. Punto unico per la distinzione usata dalla UI.
     */
    public function isZoomable(): bool
    {
        return $this->isImage() || $this->isVideo() || $this->isPdf();
    }

    /**
     * Icona Heroicon rappresentativa della categoria.
     */
    public function icon(): Heroicon
    {
        return match ($this) {
            self::Image => Heroicon::OutlinedPhoto,
            self::Audio => Heroicon::OutlinedMusicalNote,
            self::Video => Heroicon::OutlinedFilm,
            self::Pdf => Heroicon::OutlinedDocumentText,
            self::Archive => Heroicon::OutlinedArchiveBox,
            self::Document => Heroicon::OutlinedDocument,
            self::Spreadsheet => Heroicon::OutlinedTableCells,
            self::Cad => Heroicon::OutlinedCubeTransparent,
            self::Generic => Heroicon::OutlinedPaperClip,
        };
    }
}

use Spatie\MediaLibrary\MediaCollections\Models\Media;

/**
 * Categoria di file di un asset, ai fini della sola presentazione (icona).
 *
 * Logica di presentazione tenuta fuori dal model Media (di spatie): la mappa
 * mime/estensione → categoria → icona vive qui, riusabile da qualunque vista e
 * testabile in isolamento. Se in futuro arriverà un model Media custom (#18,
 * metadati), potrà esporre `icon()` come one-liner che delega a questo enum.
 */
enum AssetFileType
{
    case Image;
    case Audio;
    case Video;
    case Pdf;
    case Archive;
    case Document;
    case Spreadsheet;
    case Cad;
    case Generic;

    /**
     * Risolve la categoria da un media (estrae mime + estensione e delega a
     * {@see self::fromMime()}). Adapter di comodo: la logica resta in fromMime.
     */
    public static function fromMedia(Media $media): self
    {
        $mime = $media->getAttribute('mime_type');
        $fileName = $media->getAttribute('file_name');
        $extension = is_string($fileName) ? pathinfo($fileName, PATHINFO_EXTENSION) : null;

        return self::fromMime(
            is_string($mime) ? $mime : null,
            $extension,
        );
    }

    /**
     * Risolve una categoria dal nome del case (es. 'Image'), o null se non
     * corrisponde. Comodo per idratare il valore di un filtro/select, dato che
     * questo è un enum "puro" (non backed) e non ha un tryFrom nativo.
     */
    public static function tryFromName(?string $name): ?self
    {
        foreach (self::cases() as $case) {
            if ($case->name === $name) {
                return $case;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Risolve la categoria dal mime-type, con fallback sull'estensione per i
     * tipi il cui mime è inaffidabile o assente (dwg, zip, office…).
     */
    public static function fromMime(?string $mime, ?string $extension = null): self
    {
        $mime = strtolower(trim($mime ?? ''));
        $ext = strtolower(trim($extension ?? ''));

        // Estensione prima: per questi il mime spesso è generico/assente.
        $byExtension = match ($ext) {
            'dwg', 'dxf' => self::Cad,
            'zip', 'rar', '7z', 'tar', 'gz', 'bz2' => self::Archive,
            'doc', 'docx', 'odt', 'rtf' => self::Document,
            'xls', 'xlsx', 'ods', 'csv' => self::Spreadsheet,
            'pdf' => self::Pdf,
            default => null,
        };
        if ($byExtension !== null) {
            return $byExtension;
        }

        return match (true) {
            str_starts_with($mime, 'image/') => self::Image,
            str_starts_with($mime, 'audio/') => self::Audio,
            str_starts_with($mime, 'video/') => self::Video,
            $mime === 'application/pdf' => self::Pdf,
            in_array($mime, [
                'application/zip',
                'application/x-zip-compressed',
                'application/x-7z-compressed',
                'application/x-rar-compressed',
                'application/x-rar',
                'application/gzip',
                'application/x-tar',
                'application/x-bzip2',
            ], true) => self::Archive,
            in_array($mime, [
                'application/msword',
                'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document',
                'application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.text',
                'application/rtf',
            ], true) => self::Document,
            in_array($mime, [
                'application/vnd.ms-excel',
                'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet',
                'application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.spreadsheet',
                'text/csv',
            ], true) => self::Spreadsheet,
            in_array($mime, [
                'image/vnd.dwg',
                'application/acad',
                'application/x-acad',
                'application/dwg',
                'application/x-dwg',
                'application/autocad_dwg',
                'drawing/dwg',
            ], true) => self::Cad,
            str_starts_with($mime, 'text/') => self::Document,
            default => self::Generic,
        };
    }

    /**
     * Comodità: l'asset è un'immagine (anteprima mostrabile, dimensioni estraibili).
     * Punto unico per la distinzione "è immagine?" usata da UI e pipeline.
     */
    public function isImage(): bool
    {
        return $this === self::Image;
    }

    public function isVideo(): bool
    {
        return $this === self::Video;
    }

    public function isAudio(): bool
    {
        return $this === self::Audio;
    }

    public function isPdf(): bool
    {
        return $this === self::Pdf;
    }

    /**
     * Riproducibile inline con un player (audio/video). NB: indica la categoria,
     * non garantisce il supporto codec/contenitore del browser.
     */
    public function isPlayable(): bool
    {
        return $this->isVideo() || $this->isAudio();
    }

    /**
     * Ingrandibile (zoom/lightbox) dal pannello info: immagini e video "in grande",
     * PDF in un viewer embedded. Gli altri tipi (audio, archivi, documenti, cad,
     * generici) non hanno zoom. Punto unico per la distinzione usata dalla UI.
     */
    public function isZoomable(): bool
    {
        return $this->isImage() || $this->isVideo() || $this->isPdf();
    }

    /**
     * Icona Heroicon rappresentativa della categoria.
     */
    public function icon(): Heroicon
    {
        return match ($this) {
            self::Image => Heroicon::OutlinedPhoto,
            self::Audio => Heroicon::OutlinedMusicalNote,
            self::Video => Heroicon::OutlinedFilm,
            self::Pdf => Heroicon::OutlinedDocumentText,
            self::Archive => Heroicon::OutlinedArchiveBox,
            self::Document => Heroicon::OutlinedDocument,
            self::Spreadsheet => Heroicon::OutlinedTableCells,
            self::Cad => Heroicon::OutlinedCubeTransparent,
            self::Generic => Heroicon::OutlinedPaperClip,
        };
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Feature\Assets;

use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\User;
use AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Filament\Pages\AssetManager;
use AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Support\AssetPreview;
use Filament\Facades\Filament;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Queue;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Livewire\Livewire;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Rename di un asset dallo slideover (digital-hub 14d): il campo nome agisce
 * sul solo basename e il file fisico segue l'etichetta, così il download (che
 * usa `file_name`) resta coerente con quanto l'utente vede. Il salvataggio
 * avviene solo al submit "Salva" del form, non uscendo dal campo.
 */
class AssetRenameTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    public function test_save_renames_label_and_physical_file_preserving_extension(): void
    {
        Storage::fake('assets');
        Queue::fake();

        $this->actingAs(User::factory()->create());
        Filament::setCurrentPanel('admin');

        $product = Product::create(['name' => ['it' => 'Tavolo']]);
        $media = $product
            ->addMediaFromString('contenuto')
            ->usingFileName('foto.jpg')
            ->toMediaCollection('assets');

        $disk = Storage::disk('assets');
        $oldPath = $media->getPathRelativeToRoot();

        // l'anteprima vive nella cartella-id (non è una conversion spatie e il
        // suo path non dipende da `file_name`): il rename non deve toccarla
        $previewPath = AssetPreview::relativePath($media);
        $disk->put($previewPath, 'poster');

        Livewire::test(AssetManager::class, ['ownerType' => 'product', 'owner' => $product->getKey()])
            ->mountAction('infoAsset', ['media' => $media->getKey()])
            ->setActionData(['name' => 'Tavolo Rosso'])
            ->callMountedAction()
            ->assertHasNoActionErrors();

        // etichetta e file_name allineati, estensione preservata e basename
        // sanitizzato come gli upload spatie
        $media->refresh();
        $this->assertSame('Tavolo Rosso', $media->name);
        $this->assertSame('Tavolo-Rosso.jpg', $media->file_name);

        // il file fisico è stato spostato dall'observer (`syncFileNames`)
        $disk->assertExists($media->getPathRelativeToRoot());
        $disk->assertMissing($oldPath);
        $this->assertSame('contenuto', $disk->get($media->getPathRelativeToRoot()));

        // l'anteprima è sopravvissuta al rename
        $disk->assertExists($previewPath);
        $this->assertSame($previewPath, AssetPreview::relativePath($media));
    }

    public function test_editing_the_name_without_saving_leaves_the_file_untouched(): void
    {
        Storage::fake('assets');
        Queue::fake();

        $this->actingAs(User::factory()->create());
        Filament::setCurrentPanel('admin');

        $product = Product::create(['name' => ['it' => 'Tavolo']]);
        $media = $product
            ->addMediaFromString('contenuto')
            ->usingFileName('foto.jpg')
            ->toMediaCollection('assets');

        $oldPath = $media->getPathRelativeToRoot();
        $originalName = $media->name;

        // niente submit: il campo non salva più al blur, quindi nulla è persistito
        Livewire::test(AssetManager::class, ['ownerType' => 'product', 'owner' => $product->getKey()])
            ->mountAction('infoAsset', ['media' => $media->getKey()])
            ->setActionData(['name' => 'Mai Salvato']);

        $media->refresh();
        $this->assertSame($originalName, $media->name);
        $this->assertSame('foto.jpg', $media->file_name);

namespace Tests\Feature\Assets;

use App\Models\Product;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Livewire\Livewire;
use Spatie\MediaLibrary\MediaCollections\Models\Media;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Filtri della griglia asset (digital-hub 14c). Con almeno un filtro attivo la
 * vista è "piatta": tutti i file del record che corrispondono, a prescindere
 * dalla cartella. Senza filtri torna la normale navigazione a cartelle.
 */
class AssetFilterTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private Product $product;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        Storage::fake('assets');

        $this->actingAs(User::factory()->create());
        Filament::setCurrentPanel('admin');

        $this->product = Product::create(['name' => ['it' => 'Tavolo']]);
    }

    private function addMedia(string $name, string $mime, ?int $folderId = null): Media
    {
        $media = $this->product->addMediaFromString('x')->usingFileName($name)->toMediaCollection('assets');
        $media->setAttribute('asset_folder_id', $folderId);
        $media->setAttribute('mime_type', $mime);
        $media->save();

        return $media;
    }

    /** File name degli asset restituiti dalla griglia della Page (istanza corrente). */
    private function gridFileNames(\Livewire\Features\SupportTesting\Testable $component): array
    {
        /** @var AssetManager $page */
        $page = $component->instance();

        return $page->getAssets()->map(fn (Media $m): string => (string) $m->file_name)->sort()->values()->all();
    }

    public function test_type_filter_flattens_across_folders(): void
    {
        $folder = $this->product->createAssetFolder('A');

        $this->addMedia('img-root.jpg', 'image/jpeg');
        $this->addMedia('img-sub.png', 'image/png', $folder->getKey());
        $this->addMedia('clip.mp4', 'video/mp4', $folder->getKey());
        $this->addMedia('doc.pdf', 'application/pdf');

        $component = Livewire::test(AssetManager::class, ['ownerType' => 'product', 'owner' => $this->product->getKey()])
            ->set('filterType', 'Image');

        // entrambe le immagini, dalla root e dalla sottocartella (vista piatta)
        $this->assertSame(['img-root.jpg', 'img-sub.png'], $this->gridFileNames($component));
    }

    public function test_uploaded_by_filter(): void
    {
        $mine = $this->addMedia('mine.jpg', 'image/jpeg');
        $author = User::factory()->create();
        $mine->setAttribute('uploaded_by_id', $author->getKey());
        $mine->save();

        $this->addMedia('other.jpg', 'image/jpeg'); // senza autore tracciato

        $component = Livewire::test(AssetManager::class, ['ownerType' => 'product', 'owner' => $this->product->getKey()])
            ->set('filterUploadedBy', (string) $author->getKey());

        $this->assertSame(['mine.jpg'], $this->gridFileNames($component));
    }

    public function test_upload_date_range_filter_is_inclusive(): void
    {
        $old = $this->addMedia('old.jpg', 'image/jpeg');
        $old->setAttribute('created_at', Carbon::parse('2026-01-10 12:00:00'));
        $old->save();

        $recent = $this->addMedia('recent.jpg', 'image/jpeg');
        $recent->setAttribute('created_at', Carbon::parse('2026-03-20 12:00:00'));
        $recent->save();

        $component = Livewire::test(AssetManager::class, ['ownerType' => 'product', 'owner' => $this->product->getKey()])
            ->set('filterUploadedFrom', '2026-03-01')
            ->set('filterUploadedTo', '2026-03-31');

        $this->assertSame(['recent.jpg'], $this->gridFileNames($component));
    }

    public function test_selecting_a_folder_clears_active_filters(): void
    {
        $this->addMedia('img.jpg', 'image/jpeg');

        Livewire::test(AssetManager::class, ['ownerType' => 'product', 'owner' => $this->product->getKey()])
            ->set('filterType', 'Image')
            ->assertSet('filterType', 'Image')
            ->call('selectFolder', null)
            ->assertSet('filterType', null);
    }

    public function test_options_list_only_types_and_uploaders_present(): void
    {
        $author = User::factory()->create();
        $img = $this->addMedia('img.jpg', 'image/jpeg');
        $img->setAttribute('uploaded_by_id', $author->getKey());
        $img->setAttribute('uploaded_by_name', $author->getAttribute('name'));
        $img->save();

        $this->addMedia('doc.pdf', 'application/pdf');

        /** @var AssetManager $page */
        $page = Livewire::test(AssetManager::class, ['ownerType' => 'product', 'owner' => $this->product->getKey()])->instance();

        // solo le categorie presenti (immagine + pdf), non tutto l'enum
        $this->assertSame(['Image', 'Pdf'], array_keys($page->assetTypeFilterOptions()));
        // solo l'unico autore tracciato
        $this->assertSame([$author->getKey() => $author->getAttribute('name')], $page->uploaderFilterOptions());
    }
}

Fatto. Il task **14c** è implementato, testato e verde.

## Cosa ho fatto

**Filtri** (i tre richiesti) sull'AssetManager, come stato Livewire sulla Page custom (non è una table Filament):
- **Tipo di file** — categorie puntuali dell'enum `AssetFileType` (Immagine, Video, PDF, Documento, Foglio di calcolo, CAD, Archivio, Audio, Generico), come da tua scelta
- **Caricato da** — elenco degli autori di upload effettivamente presenti
- **Data di caricamento** — intervallo da–a su `created_at`

**Comportamento:** con almeno un filtro attivo la griglia passa a **vista piatta** su tutti i file del record che corrispondono, ignorando le cartelle (tile cartella nascoste). Senza filtri torna la normale navigazione a cartelle. Aprire una cartella azzera i filtri (globali sul record vs navigazione locale).

**File toccati:**
- [AssetManager.php](packages/digital-hub/src/Assets/Filament/Pages/AssetManager.php) — proprietà filtro, `hasActiveFilters`/`clearFilters`, `filteredAssets`/`recordAssets`, opzioni filtro, branch in `getAssets()`, reset in `selectFolder`
- [AssetFileType.php](packages/digital-hub/src/Assets/Support/AssetFileType.php) — `tryFromName()` e `label()`
- [asset-manager.blade.php](packages/digital-hub/resources/views/filament/pages/asset-manager.blade.php) — barra filtri + vista piatta + empty state dedicato
- lang it/en — chiavi filtri e `file_type_*`
- [AssetFilterTest.php](tests/Feature/Assets/AssetFilterTest.php) — 5 test

**Verifiche:** PHPStan (config template) pulito, suite `tests/Feature/Assets` 85 passati.

Note su altre due voci che comparivano nella descrizione originale del task (**tag** e **dimensioni**): le ho escluse perché non le hai chieste. Se le vuoi, le aggiungo — il filtro tag userebbe il pivot `taggables`, le dimensioni un range su width/height dai metadati.

Vuoi che verifichi il tutto anche nell'app reale (con `/run` o `/verify`)?

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Feature\Assets;

use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\User;
use AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Filament\Pages\AssetManager;
use Filament\Facades\Filament;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Livewire\Livewire;
use Spatie\MediaLibrary\MediaCollections\Models\Media;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Filtri della griglia asset (digital-hub 14c). Con almeno un filtro attivo la
 * vista è "piatta": tutti i file del record che corrispondono, a prescindere
 * dalla cartella. Senza filtri torna la normale navigazione a cartelle.
 */
class AssetFilterTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private Product $product;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        Storage::fake('assets');

        $this->actingAs(User::factory()->create());
        Filament::setCurrentPanel('admin');

        $this->product = Product::create(['name' => ['it' => 'Tavolo']]);
    }

    private function addMedia(string $name, string $mime, ?int $folderId = null): Media
    {
        $media = $this->product->addMediaFromString('x')->usingFileName($name)->toMediaCollection('assets');
        $media->setAttribute('asset_folder_id', $folderId);
        $media->setAttribute('mime_type', $mime);
        $media->save();

        return $media;
    }

    /** File name degli asset restituiti dalla griglia della Page (istanza corrente). */
    private function gridFileNames(\Livewire\Features\SupportTesting\Testable $component): array
    {
        /** @var AssetManager $page */
        $page = $component->instance();

        return $page->getAssets()->map(fn (Media $m): string => (string) $m->file_name)->sort()->values()->all();
    }

    public function test_type_filter_flattens_across_folders(): void
    {
        $folder = $this->product->createAssetFolder('A');

        $this->addMedia('img-root.jpg', 'image/jpeg');
        $this->addMedia('img-sub.png', 'image/png', $folder->getKey());

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Support;

use AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Models\AssetFolder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection as EloquentCollection;

/**
 * Operazioni ad albero sulle folder di un record, senza dipendenze da Livewire.
 *
 * Avvolge la collection già caricata delle folder ({@see AssetFolder}) e ci
 * cammina sopra in memoria: nessuna query. È la fonte unica delle derivate ad
 * albero (annidamento, breadcrumb, discendenti, altezza, opzioni di select)
 * usate dall'AssetManager, estratta per tenere AssetManager più leggero e rendere questa
 * logica testabile in isolamento.
 *
 * L'ordine dei fratelli è quello della collection passata: chi la costruisce
 * decide l'ordinamento (tipicamente `sort`), qui viene solo preservato.
 */
final class FolderTree
{
    /**
     * @param EloquentCollection<int, AssetFolder> $folders tutte le folder del record
     */
    private function __construct(private readonly EloquentCollection $folders)
    {
    }

    /**
     * @param EloquentCollection<int, AssetFolder> $folders tutte le folder del record
     */
    public static function fromFolders(EloquentCollection $folders): self
    {
        return new self($folders);
    }

    /**
     * Fratelli diretti sotto un parent (null = root), nell'ordine della collection.
     *
     * @return EloquentCollection<int, AssetFolder>
     */
    public function childrenOf(?int $parentId): EloquentCollection
    {
        return $this->folders->where('parent_id', $parentId)->values();
    }

    /**
     * Albero annidato a partire da un parent (null = root). `children` è
     * ricorsivamente la stessa struttura (non esprimibile come tipo ricorsivo
     * preciso in PHPDoc, quindi `mixed`).
     *
     * @return array<int, array{folder: AssetFolder, children: mixed}>
     */
    public function nested(?int $parentId = null): array
    {
        return $this->childrenOf($parentId)
            ->map(fn (AssetFolder $folder): array => [
                'folder' => $folder,
                'children' => $this->nested($folder->id),
            ])
            ->values()
            ->all();
    }

    /**
     * Catena dalla root alla folder data (inclusa), per il breadcrumb. null se la
     * folder — o un suo antenato — non è presente nella collection (folder
     * eliminata sotto i piedi): il chiamante decide come reagire.
     *
     * @return list<AssetFolder>|null
     */
    public function breadcrumb(int $folderId): ?array
    {
        $trail = [];
        $id = $folderId;

        while ($id !== null) {
            $folder = $this->folders->firstWhere('id', $id);
            if (! $folder instanceof AssetFolder) {
                return null;
            }

            array_unshift($trail, $folder);
            $id = $folder->parent_id;
        }

        return $trail;
    }

    /**
     * Id della folder e di tutte le sue discendenti.
     *
     * @return list<int>
     */
    public function descendantIds(int $folderId): array
    {
        $ids = [$folderId];

        foreach ($this->folders->where('parent_id', $folderId) as $child) {
            $ids = array_merge($ids, $this->descendantIds($child->id));
        }

        return $ids;
    }

    /**
     * Altezza del sottoalbero di una folder (0 se non ha figli): numero di livelli
     * sotto di essa. Serve a validare la profondità risultante quando si sposta
     * una folder con discendenti.
     */
    public function height(int $folderId): int
    {
        $max = 0;

        foreach ($this->folders->where('parent_id', $folderId) as $child) {
            $max = max($max, 1 + $this->height($child->id));
        }

        return $max;
    }

    /**
     * Opzioni per un Select "sposta in", in ordine gerarchico con rientro per
     * livello. Se $excludeId è dato, salta quella folder e tutto il suo
     * sottoalbero (una folder non può finire dentro sé stessa o un discendente).
     *
     * @return array<int, string>
     */
    public function selectOptions(?int $excludeId = null): array
    {
        $options = [];
        $this->appendOptions(null, 0, $options, $excludeId);

        return $options;
    }

    /**
     * @param array<int, string> $options
     */
    private function appendOptions(?int $parentId, int $depth, array &$options, ?int $excludeId): void
    {
        foreach ($this->folders->where('parent_id', $parentId) as $folder) {
            if ($excludeId !== null && $folder->id === $excludeId) {
                continue; // salta la folder e (non ricorrendo) il suo sottoalbero
            }

            $options[$folder->id] = str_repeat('— ', $depth) . $folder->name;
            $this->appendOptions($folder->id, $depth + 1, $options, $excludeId);
        }
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Feature\Assets;

use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\User;
use AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Filament\Pages\AssetManager;
use Filament\Facades\Filament;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Livewire\Livewire;
use Spatie\MediaLibrary\MediaCollections\Models\Media;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Filtri della griglia asset (digital-hub 14c). Con almeno un filtro attivo la
 * vista è "piatta": tutti i file del record che corrispondono, a prescindere
 * dalla cartella. Senza filtri torna la normale navigazione a cartelle.
 */
class AssetFilterTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private Product $product;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        Storage::fake('assets');

        $this->actingAs(User::factory()->create());
        Filament::setCurrentPanel('admin');

        $this->product = Product::create(['name' => ['it' => 'Tavolo']]);
    }

    private function addMedia(string $name, string $mime, ?int $folderId = null): Media
    {
        $media = $this->product->addMediaFromString('x')->usingFileName($name)->toMediaCollection('assets');
        $media->setAttribute('asset_folder_id', $folderId);
        $media->setAttribute('mime_type', $mime);
        $media->save();

        return $media;
    }

    /** File name degli asset restituiti dalla griglia della Page (istanza corrente). */
    private function gridFileNames(\Livewire\Features\SupportTesting\Testable $component): array
    {
        /** @var AssetManager $page */
        $page = $component->instance();

        return $page->getAssets()->map(fn (Media $m): string => (string) $m->file_name)->sort()->values()->all();
    }

    public function test_type_filter_flattens_across_folders(): void
    {
        $folder = $this->product->createAssetFolder('A');

        $this->addMedia('img-root.jpg', 'image/jpeg');
        $this->addMedia('img-sub.png', 'image/png', $folder->getKey());
        $this->addMedia('clip.mp4', 'video/mp4', $folder->getKey());
        $this->addMedia('doc.pdf', 'application/pdf');

        $component = Livewire::test(AssetManager::class, ['ownerType' => 'product', 'owner' => $this->product->getKey()])
            ->set('filterType', 'Image');

        // entrambe le immagini, dalla root e dalla sottocartella (vista piatta)
        $this->assertSame(['img-root.jpg', 'img-sub.png'], $this->gridFileNames($component));
    }

    public function test_uploaded_by_filter(): void
    {
        $mine = $this->addMedia('mine.jpg', 'image/jpeg');
        $author = User::factory()->create();
        $mine->setAttribute('uploaded_by_id', $author->getKey());
        $mine->save();

        $this->addMedia('other.jpg', 'image/jpeg'); // senza autore tracciato

        $component = Livewire::test(AssetManager::class, ['ownerType' => 'product', 'owner' => $this->product->getKey()])
            ->set('filterUploadedBy', (string) $author->getKey());

        $this->assertSame(['mine.jpg'], $this->gridFileNames($component));
    }

    public function test_upload_date_range_filter_is_inclusive(): void
    {
        $old = $this->addMedia('old.jpg', 'image/jpeg');
        $old->setAttribute('created_at', Carbon::parse('2026-01-10 12:00:00'));
        $old->save();

        $recent = $this->addMedia('recent.jpg', 'image/jpeg');
        $recent->setAttribute('created_at', Carbon::parse('2026-03-20 12:00:00'));
        $recent->save();

        $component = Livewire::test(AssetManager::class, ['ownerType' => 'product', 'owner' => $this->product->getKey()])
            ->set('filterUploadedFrom', '2026-03-01')
            ->set('filterUploadedTo', '2026-03-31');

        $this->assertSame(['recent.jpg'], $this->gridFileNames($component));
    }

    public function test_selecting_a_folder_clears_active_filters(): void
    {
        $this->addMedia('img.jpg', 'image/jpeg');

        Livewire::test(AssetManager::class, ['ownerType' => 'product', 'owner' => $this->product->getKey()])
            ->set('filterType', 'Image')
            ->assertSet('filterType', 'Image')
            ->call('selectFolder', null)
            ->assertSet('filterType', null);
    }

    public function test_active_filters_deselect_sidebar_folder(): void
    {
        $folder = $this->product->createAssetFolder('A');
        $this->addMedia('img.jpg', 'image/jpeg', $folder->getKey());

        /** @var AssetManager $page */
        $page = Livewire::test(AssetManager::class, ['ownerType' => 'product', 'owner' => $this->product->getKey()])
            ->call('selectFolder', $folder->getKey())
            ->instance();

        // senza filtri la sidebar evidenzia la cartella attiva
        $this->assertSame($folder->getKey(), $page->sidebarActiveFolderId());

        // con un filtro attivo nessuna voce è evidenziata (sentinella -1: né Home né cartelle)
        $page->filterType = 'Image';
        $this->assertSame(-1, $page->sidebarActiveFolderId());
    }

    public function test_options_list_only_types_and_uploaders_present(): void
    {
        $author = User::factory()->create();
        $img = $this->addMedia('img.jpg', 'image/jpeg');
        $img->setAttribute('uploaded_by_id', $author->getKey());
        $img->setAttribute('uploaded_by_name', $author->getAttribute('name'));
        $img->save();

        $this->addMedia('doc.pdf', 'application/pdf');

        /** @var AssetManager $page */
        $page = Livewire::test(AssetManager::class, ['ownerType' => 'product', 'owner' => $this->product->getKey()])->instance();

        // solo le categorie presenti (immagine + pdf), non tutto l'enum
        $this->assertSame(['Image', 'Pdf'], array_keys($page->assetTypeFilterOptions()));
        // solo l'unico autore tracciato
        $this->assertSame([$author->getKey() => $author->getAttribute('name')], $page->uploaderFilterOptions());
    }
}

PHPStan pulito, test verdi.

Fatto. I due campi data ora sono un'unica voce **"Data di caricamento"** che apre un dropdown (Alpine, chiusura su click-away/Esc) con il doppio datepicker **Dal / Al** (invariati i binding `wire:model.live` su `filterUploadedFrom`/`filterUploadedTo`).

Il trigger del dropdown mostra un riassunto dell'intervallo impostato — tramite il nuovo [uploadDateFilterLabel()](packages/digital-hub/src/Assets/Filament/Pages/AssetManager.php):
- entrambi gli estremi → `10/01/2026 – 31/03/2026`
- solo inizio → `Dal 10/01/2026`
- solo fine → `Fino al 31/03/2026`
- nessuno → `Tutti`

Traduzioni it/en aggiunte (`filter_uploaded_date`, `filter_date_from_label`, `filter_date_to_label`; rietichettati `filter_uploaded_from`→"Dal", `filter_uploaded_to`→"Al").
nella card degli asset sostituiamo data di modifica con data di caricamento, in modo che agendo sui filtri abbia un risultato concordante
Giusto: il filtro agisce su `created_at`, quindi la card deve mostrare la data di caricamento, non quella di modifica.

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Feature\Assets;

use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\User;
use AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Filament\Pages\AssetManager;
use Filament\Facades\Filament;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Livewire\Livewire;
use Spatie\MediaLibrary\MediaCollections\Models\Media;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Filtri della griglia asset (digital-hub 14c). Con almeno un filtro attivo la
 * vista è "piatta": tutti i file del record che corrispondono, a prescindere
 * dalla cartella. Senza filtri torna la normale navigazione a cartelle.
 */
class AssetFilterTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private Product $product;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        Storage::fake('assets');

        $this->actingAs(User::factory()->create());
        Filament::setCurrentPanel('admin');

        $this->product = Product::create(['name' => ['it' => 'Tavolo']]);
    }

    private function addMedia(string $name, string $mime, ?int $folderId = null): Media
    {
        $media = $this->product->addMediaFromString('x')->usingFileName($name)->toMediaCollection('assets');
        $media->setAttribute('asset_folder_id', $folderId);
        $media->setAttribute('mime_type', $mime);
        $media->save();

        return $media;
    }

    /** File name degli asset restituiti dalla griglia della Page (istanza corrente). */
    private function gridFileNames(\Livewire\Features\SupportTesting\Testable $component): array
    {
        /** @var AssetManager $page */
        $page = $component->instance();

        return $page->getAssets()->map(fn (Media $m): string => (string) $m->file_name)->sort()->values()->all();
    }

    public function test_type_filter_flattens_across_folders(): void
    {
        $folder = $this->product->createAssetFolder('A');

        $this->addMedia('img-root.jpg', 'image/jpeg');
        $this->addMedia('img-sub.png', 'image/png', $folder->getKey());
        $this->addMedia('clip.mp4', 'video/mp4', $folder->getKey());
        $this->addMedia('doc.pdf', 'application/pdf');

        $component = Livewire::test(AssetManager::class, ['ownerType' => 'product', 'owner' => $this->product->getKey()])
            ->set('filterType', 'Image');

        // entrambe le immagini, dalla root e dalla sottocartella (vista piatta)
        $this->assertSame(['img-root.jpg', 'img-sub.png'], $this->gridFileNames($component));
    }

    public function test_uploaded_by_filter(): void
    {
        $mine = $this->addMedia('mine.jpg', 'image/jpeg');
        $author = User::factory()->create();
        $mine->setAttribute('uploaded_by_id', $author->getKey());
        $mine->save();

        $this->addMedia('other.jpg', 'image/jpeg'); // senza autore tracciato

        $component = Livewire::test(AssetManager::class, ['ownerType' => 'product', 'owner' => $this->product->getKey()])
            ->set('filterUploadedBy', (string) $author->getKey());

        $this->assertSame(['mine.jpg'], $this->gridFileNames($component));
    }

    public function test_upload_date_range_filter_is_inclusive(): void
    {
        $old = $this->addMedia('old.jpg', 'image/jpeg');
        $old->setAttribute('created_at', Carbon::parse('2026-01-10 12:00:00'));
        $old->save();

        $recent = $this->addMedia('recent.jpg', 'image/jpeg');
        $recent->setAttribute('created_at', Carbon::parse('2026-03-20 12:00:00'));
        $recent->save();

        $component = Livewire::test(AssetManager::class, ['ownerType' => 'product', 'owner' => $this->product->getKey()])
            ->set('filterUploadedFrom', '2026-03-01')
            ->set('filterUploadedTo', '2026-03-31');

        $this->assertSame(['recent.jpg'], $this->gridFileNames($component));
    }

    public function test_selecting_a_folder_clears_active_filters(): void
    {
        $this->addMedia('img.jpg', 'image/jpeg');

        Livewire::test(AssetManager::class, ['ownerType' => 'product', 'owner' => $this->product->getKey()])
            ->set('filterType', 'Image')
            ->assertSet('filterType', 'Image')
            ->call('selectFolder', null)
            ->assertSet('filterType', null);
    }

    public function test_active_filters_deselect_sidebar_folder(): void
    {
        $folder = $this->product->createAssetFolder('A');
        $this->addMedia('img.jpg', 'image/jpeg', $folder->getKey());

        /** @var AssetManager $page */
        $page = Livewire::test(AssetManager::class, ['ownerType' => 'product', 'owner' => $this->product->getKey()])
            ->call('selectFolder', $folder->getKey())
            ->instance();

        // senza filtri la sidebar evidenzia la cartella attiva
        $this->assertSame($folder->getKey(), $page->sidebarActiveFolderId());

        // con un filtro attivo nessuna voce è evidenziata (sentinella -1: né Home né cartelle)
        $page->filterType = 'Image';
        $this->assertSame(-1, $page->sidebarActiveFolderId());
    }

    public function test_asset_folder_path_reflects_nesting(): void
    {
        $a = $this->product->createAssetFolder('A');
        $b = $this->product->createAssetFolder('B', $a);

        $rootMedia = $this->addMedia('root.jpg', 'image/jpeg');
        $nestedMedia = $this->addMedia('nested.jpg', 'image/jpeg', $b->getKey());

        /** @var AssetManager $page */
        $page = Livewire::test(AssetManager::class, ['ownerType' => 'product', 'owner' => $this->product->getKey()])->instance();

        $this->assertSame('Home', $page->assetFolderPath($rootMedia));
        $this->assertSame('Home / A / B', $page->assetFolderPath($nestedMedia));
    }

    public function test_options_list_only_types_and_uploaders_present(): void
    {
        $author = User::factory()->create();
        $img = $this->addMedia('img.jpg', 'image/jpeg');
        $img->setAttribute('uploaded_by_id', $author->getKey());
        $img->setAttribute('uploaded_by_name', $author->getAttribute('name'));
        $img->save();

        $this->addMedia('doc.pdf', 'application/pdf');

        /** @var AssetManager $page */
        $page = Livewire::test(AssetManager::class, ['ownerType' => 'product', 'owner' => $this->product->getKey()])->instance();

        // solo le categorie presenti (immagine + pdf), non tutto l'enum
        $this->assertSame(['Image', 'Pdf'], array_keys($page->assetTypeFilterOptions()));
        // solo l'unico autore tracciato
        $this->assertSame([$author->getKey() => $author->getAttribute('name')], $page->uploaderFilterOptions());
    }
}

        $recent = $this->addMedia('recent.jpg', 'image/jpeg');
        $recent->setAttribute('created_at', Carbon::parse('2026-03-20 12:00:00'));
        $recent->save();

        $component = Livewire::test(AssetManager::class, ['ownerType' => 'product', 'owner' => $this->product->getKey()])
            ->set('filterUploadedFrom', '2026-03-01')
            ->set('filterUploadedTo', '2026-03-31');

        $this->assertSame(['recent.jpg'], $this->gridFileNames($component));
    }

    public function test_selecting_a_folder_clears_active_filters(): void
    {
        $this->addMedia('img.jpg', 'image/jpeg');

        Livewire::test(AssetManager::class, ['ownerType' => 'product', 'owner' => $this->product->getKey()])
            ->set('filterType', 'Image')
            ->assertSet('filterType', 'Image')
            ->call('selectFolder', null)
            ->assertSet('filterType', null);
    }

    public function test_active_filters_deselect_sidebar_folder(): void
    {
        $folder = $this->product->createAssetFolder('A');
        $this->addMedia('img.jpg', 'image/jpeg', $folder->getKey());

        /** @var AssetManager $page */
        $page = Livewire::test(AssetManager::class, ['ownerType' => 'product', 'owner' => $this->product->getKey()])
            ->call('selectFolder', $folder->getKey())
            ->instance();

        // senza filtri la sidebar evidenzia la cartella attiva
        $this->assertSame($folder->getKey(), $page->sidebarActiveFolderId());

        // con un filtro attivo nessuna voce è evidenziata (sentinella -1: né Home né cartelle)
        $page->filterType = 'Image';
        $this->assertSame(-1, $page->sidebarActiveFolderId());
    }

    public function test_asset_folder_path_reflects_nesting(): void
    {
        $a = $this->product->createAssetFolder('A');
        $b = $this->product->createAssetFolder('B', $a);

        $rootMedia = $this->addMedia('root.jpg', 'image/jpeg');
        $nestedMedia = $this->addMedia('nested.jpg', 'image/jpeg', $b->getKey());

        /** @var AssetManager $page */
        $page = Livewire::test(AssetManager::class, ['ownerType' => 'product', 'owner' => $this->product->getKey()])->instance();

        $this->assertSame('Home', $page->assetFolderPath($rootMedia));
        $this->assertSame('Home / A / B', $page->assetFolderPath($nestedMedia));
    }

    public function test_options_list_only_types_and_uploaders_present(): void
    {
        $author = User::factory()->create();
        $img = $this->addMedia('img.jpg', 'image/jpeg');
        $img->setAttribute('uploaded_by_id', $author->getKey());
        $img->setAttribute('uploaded_by_name', $author->getAttribute('name'));
        $img->save();

        $this->addMedia('doc.pdf', 'application/pdf');

        /** @var AssetManager $page */
        $page = Livewire::test(AssetManager::class, ['ownerType' => 'product', 'owner' => $this->product->getKey()])->instance();

        // solo le categorie presenti (immagine + pdf), non tutto l'enum
        $this->assertSame(['Image', 'Pdf'], array_keys($page->assetTypeFilterOptions()));
        // solo l'unico autore tracciato
        $this->assertSame([$author->getKey() => $author->getAttribute('name')], $page->uploaderFilterOptions());
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Feature\Assets;

use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\User;
use AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Filament\Pages\AssetManager;
use Filament\Facades\Filament;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Livewire\Livewire;
use Spatie\MediaLibrary\MediaCollections\Models\Media;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Filtri della griglia asset (digital-hub 14c). Con almeno un filtro attivo la
 * vista è "piatta": tutti i file del record che corrispondono, a prescindere
 * dalla cartella. Senza filtri torna la normale navigazione a cartelle.
 */
class AssetFilterTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private Product $product;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        Storage::fake('assets');

        $this->actingAs(User::factory()->create());
        Filament::setCurrentPanel('admin');

        $this->product = Product::create(['name' => ['it' => 'Tavolo']]);
    }

    private function addMedia(string $name, string $mime, ?int $folderId = null, ?int $sizeBytes = null): Media
    {
        $media = $this->product->addMediaFromString('x')->usingFileName($name)->toMediaCollection('assets');
        $media->setAttribute('asset_folder_id', $folderId);
        $media->setAttribute('mime_type', $mime);
        if ($sizeBytes !== null) {
            $media->setAttribute('size', $sizeBytes);
        }
        $media->save();

        return $media;
    }

    /** File name degli asset restituiti dalla griglia della Page (istanza corrente). */
    private function gridFileNames(\Livewire\Features\SupportTesting\Testable $component): array
    {
        /** @var AssetManager $page */
        $page = $component->instance();

        return $page->getAssets()->map(fn (Media $m): string => (string) $m->file_name)->sort()->values()->all();
    }

    public function test_type_filter_flattens_across_folders(): void
    {
        $folder = $this->product->createAssetFolder('A');

        $this->addMedia('img-root.jpg', 'image/jpeg');
        $this->addMedia('img-sub.png', 'image/png', $folder->getKey());
        $this->addMedia('clip.mp4', 'video/mp4', $folder->getKey());
        $this->addMedia('doc.pdf', 'application/pdf');

        $component = Livewire::test(AssetManager::class, ['ownerType' => 'product', 'owner' => $this->product->getKey()])
            ->set('filterType', 'Image');

        // entrambe le immagini, dalla root e dalla sottocartella (vista piatta)
        $this->assertSame(['img-root.jpg', 'img-sub.png'], $this->gridFileNames($component));
    }

    public function test_uploaded_by_filter(): void
    {
        $mine = $this->addMedia('mine.jpg', 'image/jpeg');
        $author = User::factory()->create();
        $mine->setAttribute('uploaded_by_id', $author->getKey());
        $mine->save();

        $this->addMedia('other.jpg', 'image/jpeg'); // senza autore tracciato

        $component = Livewire::test(AssetManager::class, ['ownerType' => 'product', 'owner' => $this->product->getKey()])
            ->set('filterUploadedBy', (string) $author->getKey());

        $this->assertSame(['mine.jpg'], $this->gridFileNames($component));
    }

    public function test_upload_date_range_filter_is_inclusive(): void
    {
        $old = $this->addMedia('old.jpg', 'image/jpeg');
        $old->setAttribute('created_at', Carbon::parse('2026-01-10 12:00:00'));
        $old->save();

        $recent = $this->addMedia('recent.jpg', 'image/jpeg');
        $recent->setAttribute('created_at', Carbon::parse('2026-03-20 12:00:00'));
        $recent->save();

        $component = Livewire::test(AssetManager::class, ['ownerType' => 'product', 'owner' => $this->product->getKey()])
            ->set('filterUploadedFrom', '2026-03-01')
            ->set('filterUploadedTo', '2026-03-31');

        $this->assertSame(['recent.jpg'], $this->gridFileNames($component));
    }

    public function test_selecting_a_folder_clears_active_filters(): void
    {
        $this->addMedia('img.jpg', 'image/jpeg');

        Livewire::test(AssetManager::class, ['ownerType' => 'product', 'owner' => $this->product->getKey()])
            ->set('filterType', 'Image')
            ->assertSet('filterType', 'Image')
            ->call('selectFolder', null)
            ->assertSet('filterType', null);
    }

    public function test_active_filters_deselect_sidebar_folder(): void
    {
        $folder = $this->product->createAssetFolder('A');
        $this->addMedia('img.jpg', 'image/jpeg', $folder->getKey());

        /** @var AssetManager $page */
        $page = Livewire::test(AssetManager::class, ['ownerType' => 'product', 'owner' => $this->product->getKey()])
            ->call('selectFolder', $folder->getKey())
            ->instance();

        // senza filtri la sidebar evidenzia la cartella attiva
        $this->assertSame($folder->getKey(), $page->sidebarActiveFolderId());

        // con un filtro attivo nessuna voce è evidenziata (sentinella -1: né Home né cartelle)
        $page->filterType = 'Image';
        $this->assertSame(-1, $page->sidebarActiveFolderId());
    }

    public function test_max_size_filter(): void
    {
        // 1 MB e 3 MB
        $this->addMedia('small.jpg', 'image/jpeg', null, 1024 * 1024);
        $this->addMedia('big.jpg', 'image/jpeg', null, 3 * 1024 * 1024);

        $component = Livewire::test(AssetManager::class, ['ownerType' => 'product', 'owner' => $this->product->getKey()])
            ->set('filterMaxSizeMb', 2.0);

        // solo il file <= 2 MB
        $this->assertSame(['small.jpg'], $this->gridFileNames($component));

        // slider al massimo = nessun limite: filtro inattivo, torna la navigazione a cartelle
        $component->set('filterMaxSizeMb', 3.0);
        /** @var AssetManager $page */
        $page = $component->instance();
        $this->assertFalse($page->sizeFilterActive());
        $this->assertFalse($page->hasActiveFilters());
    }

    public function test_asset_folder_path_reflects_nesting(): void
    {
        $a = $this->product->createAssetFolder('A');
        $b = $this->product->createAssetFolder('B', $a);

        $rootMedia = $this->addMedia('root.jpg', 'image/jpeg');
        $nestedMedia = $this->addMedia('nested.jpg', 'image/jpeg', $b->getKey());

        /** @var AssetManager $page */
        $page = Livewire::test(AssetManager::class, ['ownerType' => 'product', 'owner' => $this->product->getKey()])->instance();

        $this->assertSame('Home', $page->assetFolderPath($rootMedia));
        $this->assertSame('Home / A / B', $page->assetFolderPath($nestedMedia));
    }

    public function test_options_list_only_types_and_uploaders_present(): void
    {
        $author = User::factory()->create();
        $img = $this->addMedia('img.jpg', 'image/jpeg');
        $img->setAttribute('uploaded_by_id', $author->getKey());
        $img->setAttribute('uploaded_by_name', $author->getAttribute('name'));
        $img->save();

        $this->addMedia('doc.pdf', 'application/pdf');

        /** @var AssetManager $page */
        $page = Livewire::test(AssetManager::class, ['ownerType' => 'product', 'owner' => $this->product->getKey()])->instance();

        // solo le categorie presenti (immagine + pdf), non tutto l'enum
        $this->assertSame(['Image', 'Pdf'], array_keys($page->assetTypeFilterOptions()));
        // solo l'unico autore tracciato
        $this->assertSame([$author->getKey() => $author->getAttribute('name')], $page->uploaderFilterOptions());
    }
}
